description: This file defines the AudioPolicyConfig class, which manages configuration data for Android's AudioPolicyManager. It includes methods for loading, creating, and modifying audio policy configurations, as well as data members for devices, modules, and formats.

classes.name: AudioPolicyConfig
classes.description: Represents the configuration for Android's AudioPolicyManager, including device lists, modules, surround formats, and related settings.
